name: Documenso
description: Documenso v2.19.0 is an open-source document signing platform backed by PostgreSQL.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Nextauth secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Next private encryption key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Next private encryption secondary key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Next private smtp password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  documenso:
    image: documenso/documenso:v2.21.1@sha256:41a69062febc915d1508b87be8c5bbe72ecd3c49232ddcd983490f5f7832f053
    container_name: documenso
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      documenso-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: ${SECRET_NEXTAUTH_SECRET}
      NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SECRET_NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
      NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY: ${SECRET_NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL: http://localhost:20030
      NEXT_PRIVATE_INTERNAL_WEBAPP_URL: http://localhost:3000
      NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://documenso:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@documenso-db:5432/documenso
      NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://documenso:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@documenso-db:5432/documenso
      NEXT_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_TRANSPORT: database
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT: smtp-auth
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST: smtp.example.com
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PORT: "587"
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME: documenso-4RI74RoG
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD}
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_NAME: Documenso
      NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS: noreply@localhost
  documenso-db:
    image: postgres:15.19@sha256:724292da1f2e50bdccfc3302ce75bbba7f4a6076701b588cc795fcac65683550
    container_name: documenso-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: documenso
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: documenso
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/database:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U documenso -d documenso"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
notes: Open http://localhost:20030. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL to the URL people will use to reach this instance. Replace the shipped NEXTAUTH and encryption secrets in the install form before storing documents. The catalog values are public. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit those literals; they do not substitute Compose variables. Replace NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST, NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME, and NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD with a real mail server before sending email. The app starts without a signing certificate, but document signing fails until you add a PKCS#12 file and NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE. See https://docs.documenso.com/docs/self-hosting/configuration/signing-certificate.
